title: Algebraic capsets
summary: Capsets are subsets of $\mathbb{F}_3^n$ with no three points on a line and a capset is complete if it is not a subset of a larger capset. We study some new constructions of capsets via algebraic equations over extensions of $\mathbb{F}_3$. In particular we construct the smallest known complete capsets with size proportional to the best known lower bound.
